insights.summary: Vivid held no earnings call; this is from its September 2026 investor presentation, its first since the April 2026 NSE Emerge listing. FY26 revenue rose 29% to ₹200 Cr with EBITDA margin up to 23% and PAT of ₹32 Cr, as data-centre switchboards grew to half of revenue (₹100 Cr, 70% hyperscale projects); H2 FY26 alone was ₹130 Cr at a 25% margin. With the Navi Mumbai plant 94% utilised, a ~120,000 sq ft automated plant at Ambernath should start by end-October 2026 and roughly triple capacity, backed by a ₹205 Cr executable order book.
